surfaces.title: Manage sub-courts
surfaces.name: Name
surfaces.hoursHelp: Leave times blank to use venue hours: {{opening}} – {{closing}}.
surfaces.help: Each sub-court has its own booking schedule. Adding or editing a sub-court does not change the venue approval status. Sub-courts with bookings or closures can only be deactivated, not deleted.
surfaces.emptyHelp: Select Add sub-court to create one for this venue.
surfaces.error: Unable to update the sub-court. Please try again.
surfaces.invalidHours: Opening time must be before closing time.
surfaces.deleteHelp: Delete {{name}}? Only sub-courts without bookings, recurring bookings or closures can be deleted. The venue must keep at least one sub-court. This cannot be undone.
surfaces.pauseHelp: Deactivate {{name}} to stop accepting new bookings? Existing bookings will be preserved. Please check the schedule and contact customers if their playing time needs to change.

images.help: New images appear publicly after approval. The previous image stays visible during replacement review and the court remains available.
